text:
claire.marketing: quick sync  planning a pricing page run: A/B tier names + calculator UX (simple vs slab). need copy, tracking, and lead routing aligned.

sam.product: copy candidates: Flex / Committed / Enterprise OR Starter / Growth / Enterprise. leaning Flex. will change UI label 'commit' -> 'monthly commit estimate' to avoid contract language.

leo.analytics: metric goals: calc_clicks, contact_sales_clicks, sales_form_submits, 7d_MQL_rate, ARR_cohort_90d. baseline simple = 4.0% conv, target slab >= 4.6%. will build dashboard tile.

mina.cs: CS asks: add FAQ anchor 'Committed capacity & latency' and ensure sales leads include hidden fields: lead_origin, experiment, variant, tier_selected so we can route and triage.

alex.growth: webinar CTA under calc: show email capture interstitial BEFORE registration; add utm_experiment=pricing_tier_test and utm_campaign=pricing_launch_blog. retarget attendees separately.

sam.product: frontend events: pricing_page_view, tier_label_click, calc_variant_exposed, calc_submit, contact_sales_click. sales form will POST hidden payload fields and map to CRM. ENG ticket ENG-2140 opened for rounding edge cases and form mapping.

deploy-bot: /deploy staging-pricing-experiment v4.0  started by claire.marketing (CI #5388) :rocket:

claire.marketing: action items: 1) copy + micro-FAQ (claire) 2) ENG fixes ENG-2140 (sam) 3) dashboard & baseline (leo) 4) CS playbook + FAQ anchor (mina) 5) webinar interstitial UX + UTMs (alex). plan flip Mon 09:00 PT, run 14 days.
